note: Overhead info views (P1.7). Each view tints the site by one value. Ramps are colorblind-safe: viridis, cividis, magma and purple-orange (ColorBrewer PuOr), checked for red-green colorblindness. 'min'/'max' fix the scale so colors mean the same thing on every site. Cells with no value get no tint. Summary text uses {name} slots.

summary.high: Land here is worth about {pct}% more than normal.
summary.low: Land here is worth about {pct}% less than normal.
summary.even: Land here is worth about normal.
summary.none: Land value is not on for this site yet.

summary.some: Busiest path: about {cars} cars at evening rush. {trucks} trucks a day.
summary.none: No cars yet. Build a driveway and something to drive to.

summary.over: More shop space than shoppers want here. Build less or build something else.
summary.room: Shoppers want more than you have built. There is room to grow.

transit.title: Transit

radius.source: N307 build default: about an 80 m walk at 8 m cells, a short stroll on the site grid
radius.why: Past this the tint stops, so the bright spot reads as the stop and its short walk, not the whole site

summary.open: The stop is open. {pct}% of the site is a short walk away.
